Orbit delivery plan — synthetic demonstration document

These work items and dependencies are authored fixtures, not inferred from source co-mentions. Each entry below explicitly records a baseline fact, accountable owner and reason for the dependency. They extend the existing synthetic meetings and emails.

Update the payment integration runbook
Owner: spk_priya. Status: open. Baseline: [fact_ep_mtg_orbit_001_017_00].
The runbook specifies Razorpay APIs and onboarding steps; a vendor change requires a review of those instructions.

Review navigation accessibility tests
Owner: spk_sana. Status: open. Baseline: [fact_ep_mtg_orbit_001_035_00].
The accessibility test plan was written for the bottom tab bar. A new navigation pattern changes focus order and tap-target checks.

Refresh the UPI release handoff
Owner: spk_rahul. Status: open. Baseline: [fact_ep_mtg_orbit_001_020_00].
The release handoff document still records September 24 for the UPI delivery. Review the documented date and completion evidence before sharing it.

Maintain the October release checklist
Owner: spk_aditya. Status: open. Baseline: [fact_ep_mtg_orbit_001_010_00].
The launch checklist is planned against the recorded October 16 release date.

Archive the original vendor sandbox spike
Owner: spk_priya. Status: completed. Baseline: [fact_ep_mtg_orbit_001_017_00].
This completed discovery spike tested the original Razorpay choice. It is retained as history and should not receive a new follow-up.
